text:
Marta Gonzalez: Quick sync  we need standardized partner inputs for the cost model: per-SKU reserved tenor discounts, min monthly guaranteed hours, spot eviction rate (per 1000h), credit policy, region mix, blackout windows, and whether capacity is shiftable across zones. paste a one-line CSV or short sample please.

Omar Singh: +1. Finance wants effective_hourly_usd at 40/70/100% util too. Also flag marketplace listing fees.

Leah Park: For ops: include ramp_hours for cross-zone migration and any maintenance blackout (local tz). small header: sku,region,tenor_months,min_hours,evict_per_1000h,credit_pct,credit_style,eff_price_40,eff_price_70,eff_price_100,ramp_hours,shiftable,listing_fee,blackout_start,blackout_end,notes

Julien Moreau (EdgeRack): here's our sample for an L40 variant. credits are invoice-offset within 3 business days; we prorate by unused committed hours. Tenor discounts are 6/12/24 months. Daypart pattern: weekday daytime higher eviction than night.

Julien Moreau (EdgeRack):
```
sku,region,tenor_months,min_hours,evict_per_1000h,credit_pct,credit_style,eff_price_40,eff_price_70,eff_price_100,ramp_hours,shiftable,listing_fee,blackout_start,blackout_end,notes
edgerack-l40,us-east,6;12;24,360,3.5,20,invoice-offset:3bd,2.85,2.10,1.65,5,true,0,2nd_sun_01:00,2nd_sun_04:00,"daypart_eviction:weekday_peak;tenor_discounts:3;6;12"
```

finance-bot: Uploaded sample: /partners/cost-inputs/edgerack-l40-20240721.csv

Marta Gonzalez: perfect. Leah, Omar  will add these fields to the ingestion spec and request normalized per-hour pricing if partners can provide.

Omar Singh: FYI if any partner supports SLA rebates for >99.95% availability include sla_rebate_pct.

Julien Moreau (EdgeRack): will upload full matrix with a small 7x24 sample for spot availability by EOD.

Marta Gonzalez: thanks everyone  we'll validate schema and run sensitivity scans.
